pretexts: message claims to be from Canada Revenue Agency
COVID-19 test results or vaccine access
new mail online in CRA My Account
payment_methods: payment to phone number via text
interac_context: Fraudulent messages claim the Government of Canada has sent money by e-Transfer and ask victims to click a link to deposit funds or provide account information for e-Transfer Autodeposit.
emerging_tactics: use of victim's full name and SIN from prior breaches
current events themed lures (Ukrainian relief, cryptocurrency, COVID-19)

kill_chain_signals.contact: Criminals send email, text, social media or voice messages appearing to be from recognizable institutions
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Message claims account needs updating, tax refund ready, delivery notification, or court notice
kill_chain_signals.payment: Text message asks that payment be sent to a phone number

red_flags: Unsolicited messages asking you to click on links
Messages asking you to download attachments
Messages asking for personal or financial information
Email address that looks legitimate but is spoofed
key_quote: Canada Revenue Agency will never ask for a payment via text message.
title: Phishing
